title: automation: the region refusal leaves a deeper suspended run uncancelled when a middle link of the suspension chain cannot be read
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #29166 dev (os-dev-report 6576781813, open_questions[1]), confirmed by the seat reading `resolveSuspensionChain` on `main` (read, not run). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 · same defect class as #29166 item (1), one link deeper.

Reach: a region whose body calls a subflow or map whose child run suspends through a chain of two or more linked runs, while the store answers for the child but fails for a deeper link.
Reader who acts: the `domain:server` lane (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` `resolveSuspensionChain`, `dag-traversal.ts` `runRegion`).

## What happens (source reading)

- #29166 item (1) (PR #29329) makes `runRegion` call `cancelRun(childRunId, reason)` once when `resolveSuspensionChain(childRunId)` comes back empty, so the strict loader owns the `error` record.
- `resolveSuspensionChain` (`engine.ts` ~L6975) walks the chain with the degrading `loadSuspendedRun`, which turns a store read failure into `null`. When the child is readable but a deeper link's read fails, the walk stops early and returns a partial chain. The deeper run is then neither cancelled nor recorded at `error`; only the degrading read's `warn` remains.

## Wanted

When `runRegion` cancels the chain, walk it with the strict loader (the shape `cancelRun` already uses), cancel every link it can read, and record at `error` each link it cannot read, naming the run id. The region refusal itself is unchanged and still thrown after.
Tests: a three-run chain whose middle link's store read fails; the readable links are cancelled; one `error` record names the unreadable link; ablation.
Clause-② expected: `no` (cancels that should have happened now happen). `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Dedupe: searched `resolveSuspensionChain`, `region suspension chain cancel`, `partial chain deeper run not cancelled`; nearest #29166 (empty chain only), #28897 (closed). **New.**

Links back: #29166, PR #29329.
